question: What are the most influential papers on SARS-CoV-2 spike protein? Return 5 with DOIs and citation counts.
final_text: {"answer":"The most influential papers regarding the SARS-CoV-2 spike protein include foundational studies on cell entry mechanisms, structural determinations via cryo-EM, and the development of mRNA vaccines targeting the spike protein.","citations":[{"doi":"10.1016/j.cell.2020.02.052","title":"SARS-CoV-2 Cell Entry Depends on ACE2 and TMPRSS2 and Is Blocked by a Clinically Proven Protease Inhibitor","citation_count":17225},{"doi":"10.1056/nejmoa2034577","title":"Safety and Efficacy of the BNT162b2 mRNA Covid-19 Vaccine","citation_count":12491},{"doi":"10.1056/nejmoa2035389","title":"Efficacy and Safety of the mRNA-1273 SARS-CoV-2 Vaccine","citation_count":8820},{"doi":"10.1126/science.abb2507","title":"Cryo-EM structure of the 2019-nCoV spike in the prefusion conformation","citation_count":7868},{"doi":"10.1038/s41586-020-2180-5","title":"Structure of the SARS-CoV-2 spike receptor-binding domain bound to the ACE2 receptor","citation_count":5424}]}

parsed.answer: The most influential papers regarding the SARS-CoV-2 spike protein include foundational studies on cell entry mechanisms, structural determinations via cryo-EM, and the development of mRNA vaccines targeting the spike protein.
